Senses shape emotion and behavior—sights, smells, and tastes trigger emotional responses and reflexes (e.g., pulling away from heat), and sensory experiences form preferences through positive or negative associations. #sensory-perception #emotion

Statistics problem asked on 2023/05/23: daily wages of 200 persons, X continuous with U=(X-130)/20 and frequencies 7,50,80,60,3 at U=-2,-1,0,1,2. Correct answers: median 140.75, Q1 127.20, Q3 154.33, D3 130.75, P98 169.67. #statistics #grouped-frequency

Method for the 200-persons wage problem: each U value is a class midpoint, so X classes of width 20 are 90-110, 110-130, 130-150, 150-170, 170-190; use value = L + ((position - cf_prev)/f)*h. #statistics #method

An earlier answer to the 200-persons wage problem (median 136.25, Q1 127.67, Q3 134, D3 131.67, P98 128.33) was wrong — it treated the U values as points instead of class midpoints and produced P98 below the median. #statistics
